comparator.name: Biology
comparator.sourceNotes: The English-taught degree combines 60 EC in year one, 90 EC in the selected major and a 30 EC minor. In this example the major includes a 15 EC supervised research project.

components.name: Laboratory Research Skills in Life Sciences
components.note: Take this course alongside Theoretical Research Skills in Life Sciences.

components.name: Theoretical Research Skills in Life Sciences
components.note: Take this course alongside Laboratory Research Skills in Life Sciences.

components.name: Medical Structural Biology
components.note: Choose Medical Structural Biology or Integrative Neuroscience. This example takes Medical Structural Biology.

components.name: Biology & Society: Ethical and Professional Aspects
Minor
components.note: Choose an eligible 30 EC minor. Some life sciences minors include the Minor Congress within those credits.

components.name: Bioanalytical and Omics Techniques
components.note: Choose Bioanalytical and Omics Techniques or Biotechnology. This example takes Bioanalytical and Omics Techniques.

components.name: Research Project Molecular Life Sciences
components.note: Earn at least 90 EC outside the minor, including all first-year courses, and take Practical Carrousel before starting the project.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The selected Molecular Life Sciences route supports a strong molecular and biomedical closest response. Ecology/evolution and behaviour/neuroscience are separately evidenced by current formal majors and target-specific interests, produce substantively different curricula and pass pairwise mechanical distinctness. Production stops at three alternatives.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both introduce cell structure, inheritance and molecular mechanisms of life.
Both study how organ systems function and maintain physiological balance.
Both study the structure and function of biomolecules, including proteins, carbohydrates and lipids.
Groningen combines cell biology with microscopy. UCR covers cell structures, signaling and division in Molecular Cell Biology.
Both develop practical microbiology skills. UCR also uses protein and DNA techniques.
Both examine inheritance, gene regulation and genetic variation. UCR also studies how these mechanisms contribute to disease.
Groningen offers a dedicated cancer course. UCR covers neoplasia within a broader course on pathology and genetics.
Groningen integrates cell biology with immunology. UCR studies these subjects in separate courses.
Both study heredity, adaptation and evolutionary processes. Groningen also covers ecological foundations in this course.
Both examine how brain function relates to behavior. UCR includes comparative neuroanatomy.
Both develop academic skills such as working with sources and communicating evidence.
Both teach Python and computational problem-solving. Groningen uses biology applications.
Groningen analyzes biological sequence and related data. UCR introduces general data analysis and uses bioinformatics tools in the laboratory course.
Groningen models biological processes. UCR teaches numerical methods and machine learning with broader applications.
Both use statistical inference to analyze empirical research. UCR applies these methods to human behavior.
Groningen examines professional and ethical issues in biology. UCR studies ethical reasoning in a broader course.
Groningen offers a separate course in microbiology. UCR includes bacterial identification and culture in its Life Science Laboratory.
Groningen offers a separate course in metabolism. UCR studies energy pathways in Biochemistry.
Groningen develops laboratory research skills in a paired sequence with theoretical research.
Groningen develops theoretical research skills alongside the laboratory course.
Groningen studies the structure of biological molecules and its medical relevance.
Both study immune recognition and responses. UCR also examines how pathogens interact with host defenses.
Groningen offers a separate course in the organic chemistry of biological molecules.
Groningen combines specialist practicals before the major research project.
Groningen develops enzyme kinetics and thermodynamics. UCR introduces enzyme function and regulation in Biochemistry.
Groningen studies microbial communities and their interactions with hosts.
Choose an eligible 30 EC minor. Some life sciences minors include the Minor Congress within those credits.
Groningen offers an advanced course in techniques for studying molecules and large biological datasets.
Groningen studies epigenetic regulation and gene editing. UCR covers gene regulation and genetic technologies within broader courses.
Groningen requires a supervised project in the major. The UCR comparison shows optional independent research separately.

notes.text: Groningen develops a specialist sequence in molecular life sciences, including structural biology, microscopy and omics, followed by a required 15 EC project. The UCR options combine biology with data analysis, environmental science or psychology.

audience.programmeDescription: This English-taught degree studies living systems from molecules and cells to organisms and ecosystems.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The Groningen example follows Molecular Life Sciences. The UCR options emphasize molecular and biomedical biology, ecology and conservation, or brain and behavior.
